description: This Java class represents a 'Sessao' (Session) entity for a ticketing system, including fields for session details such as start time, duration, total tickets, and reserved tickets, along with methods for reservations and availability checks.

classes.name: Sessao
classes.description: Entity class modeling a ticket session with properties for schedule, duration, and ticket reservation management.

methods.name: setEspetaculo
methods.description: Associates the session with an Espetaculo (show/performance).

methods.name: getInicio
methods.description: Retrieves the start DateTime of the session.

methods.name: setInicio
methods.description: Sets the start DateTime of the session.

methods.name: getDuracaoEmMinutos
methods.description: Gets the duration of the session in minutes.

methods.name: setDuracaoEmMinutos
methods.description: Sets the duration of the session in minutes.

methods.name: getDia
methods.description: Returns the session's date in short date format localized to Brazilian Portuguese.

methods.name: getHora
methods.description: Returns the session's time in short time format localized to Brazilian Portuguese.

methods.name: getTotalIngressos
methods.description: Retrieves total number of tickets for the session.

methods.name: setTotalIngressos
methods.description: Sets total tickets for the session.

methods.name: setIngressosReservados
methods.description: Updates the number of tickets reserved.

methods.name: reserva
methods.description: Reserves a specified number of tickets.

methods.name: podeReservar
methods.description: Checks if a given number of tickets can be reserved.
